strengths: Correctly identifies the plasma cell/antibody-secreting lineage from immunoglobulin genes and SDC1/TNFRSF17/MZB1 markers.
Top-k also includes isotype-committed plasma cell states, capturing the IgG/IgA signal.
weaknesses: Label is compound/unmapped and conflates plasma cell and plasmablast.
No definitive CL mapping; candidate list also includes irrelevant plasmacytoid dendritic cell.

strengths: Correctly identifies the B lineage as the parent lineage.
Top-k includes plasma cell and IgG plasma cell, so the plasma cell branch is within the method's own candidate space.
weaknesses: Top1 is under-specific; it is an ancestor of plasma cell despite abundant direct evidence for plasma cell identity.
Ignores the stronger evidence in its own sub-candidate (plasma cell score 0.9) and the pathognomonic SDC1/TNFRSF17/MZB1/JCHAIN program.

strengths: Directly matches the most specific supported ontology class with direct positive support.
Correctly distinguishes plasma cells from earlier B cells using immunoglobulin genes plus SDC1/TNFRSF17/MZB1/CD38/SLAMF7/FCRL5/DERL3 and absence of B-cell maturation markers.
Provides actionable rationale tied to the actual marker set.
weaknesses: Does not resolve IgG versus IgA isotype commitment, but the original markers support both and the parent plasma cell label is the safest specific choice.

supporting: IGHG3/IGHG2/IGHG4, IGHA1/IGHA2, IGKC, IGLC2/IGLC3, JCHAIN, and IGLL5 provide direct positive support for antibody-secreting plasma cell identity.
SDC1 (CD138), TNFRSF17 (BCMA), MZB1, CD38, SLAMF7, FCRL5, and DERL3 support terminal plasma cell phenotype.
ER/secretory markers HSP90B1, PDIA4, TXNDC5, SEC11C, SSR4, and FKBP11 support the high secretory load of plasma cells.
Enrichment for immunoglobulin-mediated immune response, humoral immune response mediated by circulating immunoglobulin, and IgG immunoglobulin complex supports plasma cell identity.
Allowed PMID 36233633 provides literature context for the plasma cell annotation.
conflicting: SCNN1B is an unusual top marker (epithelial Na+ channel subunit) and is treated as ambient/non-specific rather than a competing lineage signal.
In-house top1 CL:0000945 is under-specific relative to direct plasma cell evidence.
CASSIA's unmapped compound label conflates plasmablast with plasma cell.
enrichment_or_literature: humoral immune response mediated by circulating immunoglobulin
